page_title: GEN 2-1 VER | Genoa v Verona 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Daniele De Rossi isn't happy on the touchline after referee Michael Fabbri shows him a yellow card.
90+4' Nicola Leali (Genoa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+4' Nicola Leali (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Verona was in an offside position.
90+2' Giovane (Verona) prepares to take a corner kick.
90+1' One of the players from Verona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+1' The free kick from long range, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Giovane (Verona) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom right corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Nicola Leali, who pulls off a stunning save!
87' Gift Orban (Verona) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
85' Here's the change. Mikael Egill Ellertsson leaves the pitch and Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
85' Today's match ends for Ruslan Malinovskyi who will be replaced by Valentin Carboni (Genoa).
81' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Cheikh Niasse will be replaced by Al Musrati (Verona).
81' Substitution. Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) has come on for Rafik Belghali.
79' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.

76' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) receives the ball from the set piece and unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.

75' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
73' The referee gives a yellow card to Roberto Gagliardini (Verona).
72' Vitinha will be replaced by Patrizio Masini (Genoa).

72' Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
71' Cheikh Niasse (Verona) is penalised for holding. Michael Fabbri signals a set piece. Genoa have a free kick.
69' Genoa fail to score from a corner as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaps to collect the ball.
68' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Genoa will take a corner kick.
67' Substitution. Lorenzo Colombo is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
66' Here is a change. Daniel Mosquera is going off and Paolo Zanetti gives the last tactical orders to Gift Orban (Verona).
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Antoine Bernede will be replaced by Amin Sarr (Verona).
66' Unai Nunez (Verona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Fabbri blows for a foul. Genoa have been awarded a free kick.

62' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Mikael Egill Ellertsson sends a long raking pass onto the head of Morten Thorsby (Genoa), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the left side of the goal. 2:1.
59' Genoa are awarded a free kick from long range.
55' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Rafik Belghali (Verona).
53' A decent cross gives Morten Thorsby (Genoa) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
52' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Genoa due to an offside in the build-up play.
50' The Genoa players are exchanging some short passes.
49' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Cheikh Niasse (Verona) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Verona.
47' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Unai Nunez (Verona) for his blatant foul.

46' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Genoa are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Genoa are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
42' Michael Fabbri interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
40' 1 - 1 Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) meets a perfect cross from Vitinha deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
39' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
38' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
37' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
35' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) sends a long ball in, but Lorenzo Montipo comfortably gathers the ball.
34' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lorenzo Montipo intercepts the ball.
33' Giovane (Verona) plays a through ball but overhits it.
32' Genoa are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
30' Problems for Paolo Zanetti as Domagoj Bradaric is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Martin Frese (Verona) replaces him.
30' A cooling break is underway.
29' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) picks up an injury.
27' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
26' Nice passing game by Verona. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
24' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Rafik Belghali (Verona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.
21' Aaron Martin (Genoa) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
19' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
19' Genoa hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.

17' Giovane (Verona) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
16' Verona are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
15' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Verona win a free kick.
15' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) commits a rough challenge and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Verona.

13' Excellent touch by Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
13' Genoa enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

11' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom left corner, but Nicola Leali is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
10' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Michael Fabbri signals.
10' Verona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
9' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Verona.

9' What a great touch by Rafik Belghali (Verona) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Corner kick. Verona will have an opportunity.

8' Genoa exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely. The linesman signals a throw-in for Verona.
7' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is adjudged offside.
6' Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Aaron Martin (Genoa) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
5' A crossfield pass from Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) fails to find any of his teammates.
3' Verona are ruled offside.
2' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to gather the ball.
2' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Genoa will take a throw-in.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Verona will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Fabbri.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
